visualCharacteristics.purpose: default: 4-column grid of image cards with uppercase title and short description; locked: members-only article teasers (faded card, yellow lock badge, title, subtitle, Read more button, image)

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: image cell | body cell (heading, text, link)
contentPattern.locked: same cells; body (title, subtitle, Read more link) renders above the image, card is faded and gets a lock badge

reuseGuidance: Use for repeating image + text teasers. Add locked for members-only teasers that should look unavailable.
